analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold + MACD improving + Higher Low recovery
analysis.reason: RSI 46.6→63.4 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 -0.0210→0.0029 개선. 5일 저가($1.29)가 20일 저가($1.25)보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성. 주봉 ADX 35.8로 뚜렷한 추세 유지. 4시간봉 RSI 73.5로 과매수 진입 직전. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 1.59배로 움직임에 힘 실림. 현재가 $1.50은 볼린저밴드 상단($1.49) 근접. 스윙 저항선 $1.51 돌파 시 추가 상승 기대.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI 46.6→63.4 confirmed exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram -0.0210→0.0029 improving. 5-day low ($1.29) higher than 20-day low ($1.25) forming Higher Low pattern. Weekly ADX at 35.8 indicates a clear trend. 4-hour RSI at 73.5 nearing overbought. Volume ratio at 1.59x 5-day average, confirming momentum. Current price $1.50 approaching Bollinger upper band ($1.49). Breakout above swing resistance at $1.51 expected to fuel further upside.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.50) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1.40/$1.38/$1.31): Short-to-mid term trend confirmed above moving averages.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($1.19/$1.27): Indicates strong mid-to-long term uptrend.
· 52-week position (24.3%) + Current price level recovering from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.6→63.4): Confirmed exit from oversold territory and rising momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0210→0.0029): Improvement confirmed, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper band $1.49): Approaching upper band, indicating potential for further upside.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.38): Confirmed support based on SMA20 and Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance ($1.51): Breakout expected to strengthen the uptrend.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Recovery trend confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.59x): Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry condition met on breaking $1.51.
